gcal.title: Google Calendar
gcal.prototype: Google Calendar works in the real Madar only.
gcal.notReady: Google Calendar is not set up for this office yet.
gcal.intro: Madar puts your meetings in your Google Calendar, and keeps them up to date.
gcal.onlyThree: Google gets only the title, the time and the place of each meeting.
gcal.connected: Connected. Your meetings go to the calendar “Madar” in Google.
gcal.notSynced: Some meetings did not reach Google yet. Madar tries again by itself.
gcal.broken: Google Calendar stopped. Connect it again.
gcal.done: Connected. {{count}} meetings are on their way to Google.
gcal.done_one: Connected. 1 meeting is on its way to Google.
gcal.done_other: Connected. {{count}} meetings are on their way to Google.
gcal.disconnectBody: New changes stop. Your Madar calendar stays in Google, and you can delete it there.
gcal.disconnected: Disconnected. Your Madar calendar stays in Google.
gcal.denied: Google did not give Madar the calendar permission. Press Connect Google Calendar to try again.
gcal.failed: The Google step did not finish. Press Connect Google Calendar again.

reasons.google_not_ready: Google Calendar is not set up for this office yet.
reasons.google_link_old: The Google step took too long. Press Connect Google Calendar again.
reasons.google_link_person: This Google step belongs to another Madar sign-in. Press Connect Google Calendar again.
reasons.google_denied: Google did not give Madar the calendar permission.
reasons.google_unreachable: Madar could not reach Google. Try again in a minute.
